lines.en: Idris, I forgot to send the report to the client yesterday, but I remember talking about it this morning.
lines.pt: Idris, esqueci de enviar o relatório ao cliente ontem, mas lembro de ter falado sobre isso hoje de manhã.

lines.en: No worries, Leila. I remember seeing the file on your desk. I tried to call the client, but nobody answered.
lines.pt: Sem problema, Leila. Lembro de ter visto o arquivo na sua mesa. Tentei ligar para o cliente, mas ninguém atendeu.

lines.en: Thanks. I sent a message last night, but the system was down. Is the technician coming today?
lines.pt: Obrigado. Mandei uma mensagem ontem à noite, mas o sistema estava fora do ar. O técnico vem hoje?

lines.en: After lunch. I tried restarting the computer twice, but nothing changed, so I stopped trying and called the IT department.
lines.pt: Depois do almoço. Tentei reiniciar o computador duas vezes, mas nada mudou, então parei de tentar e liguei para a TI.

lines.en: Good. They promised to fix it last week, and nothing has changed. I am tired of this old equipment.
lines.pt: Bom. Eles prometeram consertar na semana passada, e nada mudou. Estou cansado desse equipamento velho.

lines.en: Me too. If the company had bought new computers last year, we would not have this problem today.
lines.pt: Eu também. Se a empresa tivesse comprado computadores novos no ano passado, não teríamos esse problema hoje.

lines.en: Please do not forget to attach the budget table. The client stopped to ask about the numbers last time.
lines.pt: Por favor, não esqueça de anexar a tabela do orçamento. Da última vez o cliente parou para perguntar sobre os números.

lines.en: I will attach it now. The meeting room is free at three, so we can check the numbers together.
lines.pt: Vou anexar agora. A sala de reunião está livre às três, então podemos conferir os números juntos.

lines.en: Great plan. I will never forget talking to her about the old budget; she kept asking about every line.
lines.pt: Ótimo plano. Nunca vou esquecer de ter conversado com ela sobre o orçamento antigo; ela perguntava sobre cada linha.

lines.en: Then let us prepare short answers in advance. It is better to be ready than to explain everything again.
lines.pt: Então vamos preparar respostas curtas com antecedência. É melhor estar pronto do que explicar tudo de novo.

lines.en: You are right. Thanks for your patience, Rui. I will buy coffee, and then we can start working on the answers.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Obrigado pela paciência, Rui. Vou comprar café, e depois começamos a trabalhar nas respostas.

facts.label: Verbos com -ing ou to
facts.sub: I forgot to call, but I remember seeing him. I tried restarting it, then I stopped trying.

facts.label: to ou -ing
facts.sub: Forget to + verbo: não fez. Remember + -ing: lembra do passado. Remember to + verbo: não esqueça de fazer. I forgot to send it. I remember sending it.

facts.label: parar ou pausar
facts.sub: Stop + -ing: parar de fazer algo. Stop to + verbo: parar para fazer outra coisa. She stopped talking. She stopped to ask a question.

compare.br: No Brasil, “esqueci de ligar” e “lembro de ter visto” parecem simples.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I forgot to call means I did not call.
I remember seeing him means I will see him soon.
items.why: It is a memory of the past.

items.s: Try restarting it means test a solution.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I forgot to call means I did not call. → Verdadeiro (The action did not happen.)
I remember seeing him means I will see him soon. → Falso (It is a memory of the past.)
Try restarting it means test a solution. → Verdadeiro (You test one possible way.)

pages.title: A late report · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a Boston office. A reminder says the report is late. Blake looks worried and checks his phone. His colleague Rui walks in with tea. The client is waiting for an answer. They must fix the problem before lunch.

“Rui, I forgot to send the report to the client yesterday, but I remember talking about it this morning.” says Blake. “No worries, Blake. I remember seeing the file on your desk. I tried to call the client, but nobody answered.” says Rui. “Thanks. I sent a message last night, but the system was down. Is the technician coming today?” says Blake.
